schema.note: Read by PokeLab.Core.Loc. Keys are dotted and grouped by the system that shows them. Every string a player reads that is not a proper name belongs here.
schema.korean: Written as a Korean game writes, not as English put through a translator. No '그것은', no '~하는 것이다', no padding adverbs; the sentence ends where Korean ends it. Where the series has an established Korean term, that term wins over a more literal one.

entries.en: The water is deep and cold. Nothing here could carry you across.
entries.ko: 물이 깊다. 여기서는 건널 방법이 없다.

entries.en: The water is deep. Something is stopping you anyway.
entries.ko: 물이 깊다. 그런데 무언가가 앞을 막고 있다.

entries.en: The water is deep here. Cross on {0}?
Three of them. Not one is a better choice than the others — only a different one. Take your time.
entries.ko: 세 마리다. 어느 쪽이 더 낫다는 건 없다. 다를 뿐이지. 천천히 골라라.

entries.en: There is no room left in the bag.
Shall I take a look at your Pokémon?
They are back on their feet. Come again.
The battle resolved without a stage to show it on.
entries.ko: 전투를 보여줄 무대가 없어 결과만 처리했다.
